jobs.title: (Senior) Product Owner
jobs.description:
At bunq, we're not just building a banking app; we're reshaping how people around the world experience financial freedom. We have several exciting and immediate openings within our Product sector. Submit your application, and our team will work with you to understand your unique skillset and interests, helping you find the perfect current opportunity that suits your career aspirations.

Take ownership

jobs.title: Head of Design, AI Builder (all genders)
jobs.description:
ABOUT BABBEL LABS

Babbel Labs is building the future of language learning. We are an AI-first, independent company within the Babbel group, based in Berlin. Our teams bring AI, research and product together to ship experiences that set a new standard for how people learn.




THE ROLE

We're a small, fast-moving team rethinking how people learn languages with AI. We're looking for an experienced product designer to take over hands-on design leadership: shaping the product's direction, running discovery, and getting work delivered.

This is a design leadership and mentoring role, not a people management role. You'll guide the craft and direction of the design team. Speed, precision and quality are how we work. You'll set the pace. You'll work AI-first, using various ways to test ideas quickly and turning the best ones into experiences that are ready to hand off.




HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT

 - Lead design across discovery and delivery, owning key design decisions for AI-first language learning experiences.

 - Design AI-powered learning experiences. Shape how learners interact with AI, from conversation and voice to feedback that stays clear and trustworthy even when the AI gets things wrong.

 - Work as an AI builder. Use AI tools first to speed up research, exploring ideas, prototyping and delivery.

 - Prototype in code. Build prototypes in SwiftUI and HTML to test ideas and produce vision prototypes that are ready to hand off.

 - Design with Claude Code and Figma together. Figma is one tool among several here, not where every project starts.

 - Coach and mentor the small, experienced design team, who also work as AI builders, and help them share one set of AI-first design principles.

 - Work across disciplines with engineers, product managers, linguists and language learning specialists.




YOUR SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

 - Proven design leadership. Solid experience leading product design, with a record of shipping work that users actually adopted.

 - Excellent UI craft and motion design. Learning happens moment by moment, so polished interfaces and purposeful motion are essential to a great learning experience.

 - Hands-on prototyping in code. You're comfortable in SwiftUI and HTML/CSS/JS and can build things people can use and test.

 - AI fluency. You use AI tools like Claude Code as a real part of how you design, not an add-on.

 - Design systems know-how. A working knowledge of design systems and how they make teams faster and more consistent.

 - A coaching mindset. Experience coaching designers and raising a team's standards through example, feedback and shared practices.

 - Clear communication. You work well with technical and non-technical partners, including specialists like linguists and learning designers.

 - Comfort with ambiguity. You thrive on fast iteration and figuring things out as you go.




WHAT YOU'LL GET

 - Room to learn new tools as they arrive. Try them on real work as soon as they come out, and help decide what the team adopts.

 - A consumer product used around the world. Design for a live product that real learners use every day, globally.

 - A competitive salary. 




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Delivery-ready prototypes. Prototypes that give engineering and stakeholders a clear vision to build from.

 - Faster, better design work. Quality and speed improve through AI tools and design systems.

 - An aligned design team. A team that is coached, confident and aligned on AI-first design principles.




WAYS OF WORKING

This is a hands-on design leadership role on a small, experienced design team that works AI-first. AI tools are built into how the whole team works every day, from discovery to delivery. It is hybrid: a mix of time together in the office and working remotely.




DIVERSITY AT BABBEL

As part of our ongoing journey towards building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company, we welcome everyone to apply, especially individuals who are underrepresented in tech. We are a learning company, inside and out, and we encourage you to apply even if you do not fit all the technical requirements — all candidates are assessed based on skills, qualifications, and our business needs. Please state your pronouns in your application, and let us know if you'd like to be addressed by a name other than the one appearing on your official documents. If you have a disability or special need, feel welcome to inform us so we can provide proper assistance in the application process.

jobs.title: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
PRODUCT DESIGN DIRECTOR - PATIENT (X/F/M)


THE OPPORTUNITY

Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly 3,000 people work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced.

More than 500,000 healthcare professionals use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately 90 million people across Europe.

For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an AI-powered Health Companion that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.

This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.

We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.


WHAT YOU WILL BUILD AND LEAD

As Product Design Director, Patient, you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams. 

Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including:

 - access to care, search and booking;

 - patient messaging and teleconsultation;

 - the Patient Health Record and patient context;

 - the app homepage and daily health experience;

 - health content and prevention;

 - recommendations, reminders and care plans;

 - new patient services and subscription experiences;

 - conversational and AI-powered experiences.

The current team includes six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer. You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.


YOUR MANDATE

You will:

 - Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey.

 - Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.

 - Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.

 - Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.

 - Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.

 - Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.

 - Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.

 - Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business.

 - Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts.

 - Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first year, you will have:

 - established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream;

 - raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences;

 - helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences;

 - strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical;

 - developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;

 - helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You are likely to bring:

 - Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership..

 - Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people.

 - A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance.

 - Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers.

 - Strong product design craft and creative judgement. You can recognise excellent work, make difficult quality trade-offs and stay close enough to the details to raise the standard of the product.

 - Experience connecting design choices to measurable outcomes such as adoption, conversion, engagement, retention, satisfaction or user behaviour.

 - A strong and practical understanding of AI-native product experiences. You have thought deeply about how AI changes interaction design, user expectations, trust, transparency and control.

 - Experience designing with uncertainty, recommendations, personalisation or conversational interfaces is highly relevant.

 - The ability to operate across complex products and stakeholders, while maintaining clarity and momentum.

 - A concise and compelling communication style. You can articulate a clear point of view, align senior stakeholders and inspire teams to move in a new direction.

 - Experience in healthcare or another regulated, trust-sensitive environment is valuable, but healthcare experience is not required. What matters is your respect for domain expertise and your ability to design responsibly in high-stakes contexts.

 - Fluency in English. French or German would be a strong plus.

 - A working style aligned with the Doctolib Playbook: User First, Medical Expertise, Forefront of Innovation, Bold, Drive, Passion, Humility.


WHY DOCTOLIB, WHY NOW?

Doctolib gives you the opportunity to work on a consumer product with significant reach, strong European scale and a mission that matters.

The patient product already has a large and engaged audience. The next challenge is to make the experience more useful, more contextual and more present in people’s everyday health journeys.

You will join at a defining moment:

 - Doctolib is moving from appointment booking towards continuous health support.

 - AI is becoming a core part of the product experience, not an isolated feature.

 - The Patient Design organisation is being strengthened and reshaped.

 - The product must work across multiple European countries, languages and healthcare systems.

 - The design foundations for the next chapter are still being built.

This is an opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of consumer product design, healthcare and AI, and to define how people will discover, understand and manage their health in the future.

 

Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products and improve healthcare for more people. We welcome applications regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability or place of origin. If you have a disability, please let us know how we can make the recruitment process more accessible.

Information submitted through this application is processed by Doctolib for recruitment purposes. For more information about data processing and your rights, please refer to our privacy policies:

France https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-FR

Germany https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-DE

Italy https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-IT

The Netherlands https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-COM

For questions about data privacy, please contact hr.dataprivacy@doctolib.com.

This opportunity is based in our London office, and because we value a collaborative work environment and genuine human interactions, it is mostly an office‑based role.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/073d243b-47d6-434c-bd82-52587fc7ee3e/banner_narrow_newgames.jpg]

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1246dead-d30e-4c70-a1d3-ef7e5023d542/59312fce-38f1-4487-9f02-58e06d5fa7c0/Screenshot%202026-03-25%20at%2010.43.35.png]

The Supercell Recruitment team

jobs.title: Product Designer, Generative Media (Staff-Level / L6)
jobs.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.



Location: Europe remote or London hybrid




THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Staff (L6) Product Designer to lead design for Synthesia's AI Playground: our dedicated generative-media workspace where users experiment with leading AI models to create video clips, images, and motion graphics, then feed those assets into Synthesia Studio videos.

Playground sits at an intentional crossroad: it's both a creation destination in its own right and a strategic on-ramp that converts experiments into polished videos. The product is evolving rapidly - from a single-format surface into a multi-format creation hub (video, images, motion graphics) with Templates & Apps ahead. 

You'll operate as a senior IC: setting direction, influencing roadmap decisions (not just contributing), shaping bets with Product and Engineering leaders and raising the craft bar on how generative tools actually feel.

In practice, this role is about solving generative-media design problems, for example:

 - Designing prompt experiences and iteration workflows that make complex AI capabilities feel accessible and powerful - giving users meaningful agency without overwhelming them.

 - Balancing discovery across multiple media formats so none feels buried, while scaling for Templates, Apps, and future workflows.

 - Designing the invisible handoff between Playground creation and Studio editing - so experiments flow naturally into polished videos.

 - Working at the frontier of how generative media changes what "creation" means, where the best patterns are genuinely still being invented.
   
   


IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Own Playground's evolution end-to-end: from single-format surface to scalable multi-format creation hub.

 - Set design direction for discovery, experimentation, and iteration across all formats. Influence adjacent product areas (Studio, Media Library) to stay coherent.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering to define what "great" looks like (principles, quality bar, metrics) and drive toward it.

 - Prototype and test interaction models quickly. Know when high-fidelity matters versus learning through Lo-Fi.

 - Raise the bar on craft: prompt UX, format balance, iteration workflows, and the feel of creating with AI at speed.
   
   


YOU SHOULD APPLY IF YOU BRING:

 - Significant experience designing creation tools or generative-media platforms where users explore, iterate, and refine outputs quickly.

 - Strong craft in interaction and visual design. A track record of shipping delightful experiences around complex workflows.

 - Deep comfort designing around AI model constraints. You design UX that works with constraints, not around them.

 - Systems thinking. You can hold the tension between Playground as a destination and as an on-ramp to Studio.

 - Experience designing multi-format products. You know how to give equal weight to different experiences and scale beyond an initial, focused surface.

 - Excellent communication in design reviews and cross-functional tradeoffs between user delight and business goals.

 - A track record of tackling novel problems in fast-moving generative-media spaces and turning early-stage bets into scalable platforms.

 - The ability to leverage feedback from users and customers to ensure the product continues to meet real needs - from SMBs shipping quick marketing videos through to Enterprise teams producing at scale.




AT SYNTHESIA WE EXPECT EVERYONE TO:

 - Put the Customer First

 - Own it & Go Direct

 - Be Fast & Experimental

 - Make the Journey Fun

You can read more about this in this public Notion page: https://synthesia.notion.site/How-we-work-at-Synthesia-f794caa72f8446efb6be22b551ce0fa2





BENEFITS

 - A flexible, remote friendly role based out of Europe or one of our hubs in London, Copenhagen, Munich, or Zurich. 

 -  25 days of annual leave + public holidays in the country where you are based.

 - A generous referral scheme.

 -  Work from home set up.

 - At Synthesia, you can work from anywhere (within reason) in the world for up to 60 days per year!

 - A huge opportunity for career growth as you’ll help shape a market-defining product.

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
Who we are
Mindtickle is the leading AI-powered revenue enablement platform, helping sales teams learn faster, practice smarter, and perform at their best. We bring together onboarding, training, coaching, content, digital sales rooms, conversation intelligence, and AI role-plays into one platform so revenue teams have everything they need to build winning sellers.
Global companies, like Fortune 500 organizations, trust Mindtickle to support their revenue teams. Customers and industry analysts have also recognized us. G2 has ranked us the #1 Sales Training & Onboarding platform for 28 consecutive quarters, and Forrester has recognized Mindtickle as a Leader in revenue enablement. Mindtickle was also recognized as AI-Based Sales Solution of the Year by the 2025 AI Breakthrough Awards and has received Stevie Awards for Technology Innovation and Customer Support Excellence.
At Mindtickle, we're helping companies create high-performing revenue teams, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.


About the Role
We are looking for a highly skilled and passionate product designer with an unwavering commitment to user-centered design. This passion translates into flawless execution, leveraging a deep understanding of design patterns to create best-in-class experiences across a variety of user journeys that are part of the Mindtickle content platform. 
You will play a pivotal role in defining the strategy and vision for managing, generating, and sharing content for our key personas - enablement admin and sellers. Collaborating closely with designers, product managers, engineers, and researchers, you will design intuitive, engaging experiences that help revenue teams succeed.
Responsibilities
Bring coherence to the content platform workflows, unifying AI content creation workflows and governance into one delightful experience for customers 
From concept to delivery, you will be responsible for defining the user experience, creating wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.
Deeply understand user needs and behaviors: Conduct user research, analyze data, and synthesize insights to inform design decisions.
Design scalable, AI-enhanced, enterprise-grade analytics solutions for B2B SaaS.
Create frameworks and patterns that enable consistent visualization approaches across different feature areas and user journeys
Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams: Work closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, and other designers to ensure a cohesive and impactful user experience.
Stay up-to-date on industry trends: Keep abreast of the latest developments in design and AI.
Mentor and partner with junior designers to share knowledge and contribute to a collaborative learning environment. 
Qualifications
Minimum of 6 to 8 years of relevant experience in product design, specifically in B2B SaaS environments.
Strong portfolio demonstrating complex problem-solving. Experience with designing AI products is a must-have.
Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and methodologies.
Strategically builds consensus and trust across diverse stakeholders with competing priorities
Manages project expectations through appropriate visibility, negotiating scope and timelines to preserve design integrity while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships.
Good understanding of design systems, UI libraries, and knowledge of how to build with these.
Navigates ambiguity and incomplete information confidently
Proficiency in design tools such as Figma and prototyping tools like Claude Design, Figma Make etc.
A link to your portfolio is mandatory to be considered for this role
What we offer
Opportunity to shape the future of our platform.
Competitive compensation
Collaborative environment with a direct impact on product strategy
Work alongside top design professionals, sharpening your skills and expanding your design acumen.
Shape the next generation of designers by coaching and guiding junior team members in a collaborative environment.

A global product used by enterprise revenue teams worldwide, built by a product team in India.

Competitive compensation

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (B2C)
Senior Product Designer - Feegow (100% remote friendly in Brazil)
jobs.description:
Welcome to the good side of tech 👋

You might have heard about us, but with a different name: Doctoralia. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

At Docplanner we are a diverse group of over 300 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.

We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.es/Overview/Working-at-DocPlanner-EI_IE1071394.11,21.htm?countryRedirect=true speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us https://bit.ly/3xwnSAk.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. Your impact? Helping millions take back control of their online security, privacy, and data.

The Design Team is a dynamic, multidisciplinary group of Product designers, UX/UI designers, UX researchers, UX writers, and Graphic designers. We're building the future of digital freedom across our cybersecurity suite products, such as NordVPN, NordPass, Saily & Coveron. We are helping millions of users own their online lives. We aim to simplify the complex world of cybersecurity for everyone. We thrive on honest feedback to help each other grow and believe in the freedom to take initiative, be bold, and run with new ideas.

We're looking for a Product Designer to own the experience where users control their relationship with our products — the User Control Panel (UCP) and account management platform.




MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own your surface end to end. Core account lifecycle experience is yours. On occasion, you'll also shape internal tools or Support Center flows where they touch the core account experience. From raw insight or vague ticket to a clear problem statement, explored directions, and a shipped, measured solution.

 - Push the problem, not just the pixels. You'll surface assumptions early with your PO and engineers, challenge briefs when the evidence points elsewhere, and sometimes make the call that the best design is removing a flow entirely.

 - Craft with the system. Apply our design system without losing intent and help it grow. When you spot a gap, you propose the component, not the workaround.

 - Ship, don't just design. Back your decisions with evidence while partnering with UX Research or running validation yourself. Stay close to engineers through the build and own Design QA so what ships is what you intended.

 - Collaborate like it's one team. You'll work daily with POs and engineers, and partner with UX writers and researchers where their craft matters most — because on account surfaces, the right words carry as much weight as the right flow.




CORE REQUIREMENTS

 - Proven product design experience. 3+ years designing web products end to end; experience with account, subscription, or platform surfaces is a strong plus.

 - Fluent in systems, sensitive to detail. Design systems are your default starting point, and the small things — states, edge cases, microcopy — don't escape you.

 - Comfortable in ambiguity. Unclear inputs don't stall you; they're where you do your best shaping.

 - Curious about the business side. Retention, trust, and self-service metrics aren't someone else's job — they inform how you design.

 - Clear communication. Plain language, direct feedback, no ego — you raise the quality of every conversation you're in. Fluent in English.

 - Own your fitness: in-house gyms, sport cards, online workouts, and personal guidance — on us.

ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting



We're looking for an experienced and proactive Senior Product Designer to join our Product Design team at Zable (Lendable). You'll join a team of 5 product designers and report to the VP of Product & Design.



You'll work mainly on the Zable app, our financial SuperApp with 2M+ monthly active users. It brings together credit cards, loans, memberships, mobile and more in one place. You'll own complex product areas end-to-end, from discovery and research through to polished, production-ready design. You'll set design direction alongside PMs and Engineering, mentor other designers, and help raise the bar for craft and outcomes across the team.




THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

 - 5+ years of product design experience, ideally in fintech or a fast-paced startup

 - Strong mobile app and web experience

 - Customer-obsessed and data-literate: you challenge solution-led briefs and back decisions with evidence

 - Takes real creative risks, and can bring a team along with a clear story for why a bolder direction is right

 - Confident with senior stakeholders, and pushes back when quality or customer outcomes are at risk

 - AI-native: you push past the first obvious output, not just work faster

 - Enjoys raising the bar for other designers through mentoring and feedback

 - Bonus:
   
   - Designing AI-powered products (explainability, human override)
   
   - Shipping improvements without engineering, e.g. via CMS or no-code tools
   
   - Regulated environments, e.g. Consumer Duty
   
   - UX writing
     
     


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Lead discovery, choosing the right research method and turning findings into clear design direction

 - Own design delivery for your squad, from first flows through to build

 - Work with engineers throughout design, not just at handoff, weighing build cost in your decisions

 - Contribute to the design system, and know when breaking from it is right for the customer

 - Run usability tests and experiments with clear measures of success

 - Use AI across your workflow, including pushing design changes to production yourself

 - Design to Consumer Duty and accessibility standards, and call out issues in others' work

 - Run design critiques and write rationale that stands on its own




OUR DESIGN PRINCIPLES

 1. Simplicity wins
    
    1. If a user has to think too hard, we’ve already lost. We strip away complexity, jargon, and unnecessary steps to make managing finances effortless. Every screen should feel intuitive, focused, and frictionless.

 2. Evidence over ego
    
    1. We don’t design based on opinions. Everything we build is informed by data, tested, and refined based on real user behavior.

 3. Trust is our best feature
    
    1. Finance is built on trust. Every design decision should reinforce transparency, security, and user confidence. We prove we care by helping users make financial decisions that empower them.
       
       

Interview Process

 - CV screening

 - An introductory call with someone from the Talent Team and/or hiring manager

 - A take-home exercise to complete in your own time

 - Task debrief with members of the design team (45 mins)

 - Final round in person at the office (3x30 min, same day):
   
   - VP Product & Design
   
   - Engineering team members
   
   - Final round interview with our CPO




LIFE AT LENDABLE

 - Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

 - Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

 - Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

 - Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

 - Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

 - Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

 - Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

 - Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog https://blog.lendable.co.uk/!

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description:
UNLEASH AI INNOVATORS, SECURELY

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate.  It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Why this role?

AI agents now write, review and ship a growing share of the world's software. That changes how engineering teams work, and it changes what "secure" means.

At Snyk, we're building a new AI-native security platform from the ground up. It's built for a world where engineering and security teams hand work to agents, work alongside them, and need to trust what comes back.

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll work with product, engineering and security research to define that platform. That means shaping how people and agents work together, and helping make security part of the engineering workflow rather than a step that slows it down.

This role is for you if you care about making software safer, you're curious about how engineering is changing with AI, and you want to help decide what comes next rather than react to it.

What you'll do

 - Own design end to end for a zero-to-one AI security product: problem framing, research, interaction model, and shipped UI.

 - Set the direction for the agent experience: how security and engineering teams hand off work to agents, follow progress, step in, and approve what agents produce.

 - Define AI interaction patterns (agent actions, confidence, explanations, human-in-the-loop controls) that earn developers' trust.

 - Design for where developers actually work: CLI, IDE, pull requests, and AI coding agents, as well as the web.

 - Frame problems nobody has named yet. Research strategic questions, not just usability ones, and write up answers product and engineering can act on.

 - Model the system: agents, workflows, policies, findings and fixes, and how they relate. Name the gaps between teams instead of working around them.

 - Prototype in code with AI tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor), explore many directions quickly, and test with real users within days.

 - Ship production code alongside engineering: raise PRs with code from a coding agent, using our design system components, instead of handing off static files.

 - Lead workshops and sprints that align product, engineering and security research when the direction is unclear.

 - Raise the AI fluency of the wider design team through coaching, shared tools and example workflows.

What you bring

 - 8+ years in product design, with significant time spent designing for developers: dev tools, security, cloud, infrastructure, or APIs.

 - A portfolio showing shipped work for technical users, including complex workflows and enterprise constraints.

 - End-to-end craft: interaction design, information architecture and visual polish, with the systems thinking to turn new patterns into reusable ones. You move between strategy and pixel-level detail.

 - An AI-native workflow you can show: working prototypes, tools or agents you've built with coding agents in the last 6 months and put in front of users, not just prompts.

 - Strong judgement on agent UX: when to automate and when to ask, how to show reasoning and uncertainty, how people review, approve and step in, and how to recover when an agent gets it wrong.

 - Clear storytelling with executives, engineers and customers alike.

Nice to have

 - Domain experience in application security, software supply chain security, or AI and agent security: MCP servers, prompt injection, AI governance.

 - PRs opened to a production codebase using code from a coding agent.

 - Agents, skills, MCP servers or AI workflows you've built yourself, at work or on the side.

 - Shipped work on orchestration, observability or governance products.

In your application, include

 - A portfolio with at least one shipped project for technical users.

 - One thing you built with a coding agent, such as a repo, a PR, a live prototype or a short walkthrough video, and what you'd change next time.


ABOUT SNYK

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.




EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

About Calm

Calm is the leading mental health brand on a mission to make the world happier and healthier. Known for its flagship consumer app—ranked #1 in its category with over 180 million downloads and availability in ten languages across 190 countries—Calm helps people sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully through content and tools from experts and beloved celebrity voices. Building on this foundation, Calm has created a broader portfolio including evidence-based solutions like Calm Health, offered through employers, health plans and providers, designed to expand access to mental health and sleep support, boost benefits engagement, and drive positive health outcomes. Today, Calm supports more than 3,500 organizations and reaches over 42 million covered lives through Calm Health. Calm has been recognized as a TIME100 Most Influential Company and one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter. Learn more at calm.com.

What We Do

At Calm we believe in making relaxation, better sleep, and mindfulness accessible to the entire world, and we hope you will help us achieve our mission. The Product & Design team is responsible for delivering Calm to our customers, ensuring that it is easy to use, supports their goals, and maintains a high level of quality across web, iOS, Android platforms.

As a Senior Product Designer on our Consumer team, you'll shape experiences used by tens of millions of people to sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully. People often reach for Calm in their most vulnerable moments, so the craft of what we make (how it looks, moves, and feels) matters enormously. 

This is a builder's role in the truest sense: you'll use AI and modern prototyping tools to move from insight to interactive prototype to shipped experience, not as a shortcut on quality, but to spend less time producing and more time on the judgment and detail that make an experience great. When anyone can generate a hundred screens in an afternoon, taste and judgment are the differentiators! 

The heart of this role is balancing velocity and craft in service of making our users healthier and happier, and building intuitive, engaging and impactful experiences that drive acquisition, engagement and retention.  You'll partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, and Marketing, and set the standard for craft across iOS, Android, and web.  You will be a thought leader in design, helping to establish best practices and setting the bar for exceptional product design at Calm.

What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end product design initiatives that cover the whole product experience (visual, interaction, motion, brand integration), to create thoughtful, high-quality user-centered mobile experiences.
  • Prototype quickly in Figma and with AI and low-code tools like Replit, Lovable, and Claude, so you can get real, testable ideas in front of people early.
  • Present your design work clearly and persuasively to cross-functional stakeholders (including senior leadership), give and take feedback well, anchoring your rationale to both user needs and business goals.
  • Maintain strong attention to detail and collaboration through engineering implementation (build and QA) and post launch-iterations, to ensure high-quality execution.
  • Use data and drive research to inform the experiences you build, and leverage performance insights to evolve your approach.
  • Champion system-level thinking (improving how the team works and evolving Calm's design system) so the whole team works faster and smarter.
  • Balance multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of execution. 

Who You Are

  • Experienced Product Designer: 7+ years of experience in UX and UI design with 5+ within consumer mobile and web applications.
  • AI-native and tooling-fluent: Highly proficient in Figma for design, and already using AI and low-code tools (Replit, Lovable, Claude) to prototype and move fast, with the judgment to know when the output is good enough and when it isn't.
  • Technical agility: Comfortable shipping small code changes without engineering support, bridging the gap between design and engineering by personally shipping copy and UI polish directly.
  • A builder: Biased toward shipping and iterating over perfect plans. You'd rather put a working prototype in front of people than write a doc about one.
  • Data- and research-informed: You fold both qualitative and quantitative insight into your design decisions, and you measure whether the work landed.
  • A strong collaborator: A low-ego, trusted partner to Product, Research, and Engineering who makes the people around them better and helps sharpen how the team works.
  • High craft standards: A strong advocate for accessibility, consistency, visual storytelling, brand integration, and motion design to create engaging user experiences, while still maintaining velocity.
  • A clear communicator: You present your thinking persuasively to stakeholders and senior leadership, give and take feedback well, and champion an experience while staying open to being wrong.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with conversational or AI-native UX.
  • Experience working at multiple organizations, ideally including time at a consumer product in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating your ability to design and ship beautiful, functional, and user-friendly experiences.
  • Comfort shipping small copy and UI changes directly in code, without engineering support.
  • A passion for Calm's mission and a point of view on how digital products can support mental health.

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years in UX/UI design with 5+ within consumer mobile (and web) applications.
  • Proven experience driving user testing and research.
  • Strong foundation in interaction design, visual design, and usability best practices.
  • Experience designing and shipping mobile applications at scale.
  • Hands-on proficiency in Figma and modern AI/prototyping tools.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a larger design vision and strategy.

Calm uses a geographic pay model that determines salaries based on the location where an employee lives. For this position, the base pay ranges across Calm’s pay tiers is as follows: $168,000 - $245,000. The base pay range represents the low and high end of Calm’s salary range for this position. Not all candidates will be eligible for the upper end of the salary range. Exact salary will ultimately depend on multiple factors, which include the successful candidate's geographic location, skills, experience and other qualifications. Calm uses employee zip code to determine which pay range applies. This role is also eligible for equity + comprehensive benefits + 401k + flexible time off.

Calm may incorporate artificial intelligence technology to support the application review process, but rest assured that human reviewers are involved in all stages of the hiring process.

Calm is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities, including disabled veterans. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or interview process, please contact Calm’s Recruiting team at recruitingaccommodations@calm.com. All accommodation requests will be handled confidentially and assessed on a case-by-case basis.

We believe that mental health is health, and every person should be considered in the discussion. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Calm is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. We strive to create a mindful and respectful environment where everyone can bring their authentic self to work, and experience a culture that is free of harassment, racism, and discrimination.

Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check. Roles which require access to certain types of information may also require the successful completion of a drug screening.

jobs.title: Sr. UX Designer, Security
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://cribl.io/

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help define and deliver Cribl security product experience. You will design for security practitioners across detection, alerting, investigation, triage, search, threat coverage, telemetry, and AI-assisted workflows.

This role requires a genuine security background and the ability to turn complex SOC workflows into clear, trustworthy experiences. You will partner with Product, Engineering, UX Research, and other designers to create a cohesive experience that works seamlessly with our other products across the entire Cribl platform.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Lead end-to-end design from problem framing and research through interaction design, prototyping, validation, and implementation.
  • Design workflows for detection creation and management, alert review, investigation, triage, search pivots, threat coverage, normalization, and enrichment.
  • Apply security judgment to evidence, provenance, confidence, severity, permissions, auditability, destructive actions, and operational risk.
  • Design AI-assisted and agentic experiences that make intent, context, sources, capabilities, uncertainty, and user approval clear.
  • Use Cribl’s design system and contribute reusable components, patterns, guidance, and interaction models when the work has broader value.
  • Work expertly in Figma for exploration, prototyping, documentation, collaboration, and handoff, including libraries, variables, components, variants, and tokens.
  • Partner with engineers, PMs and designers through ideation, development to support feasibility, accessibility, resilience, and high-fidelity implementation challenges.
  • Share work early and often through critiques and working sessions. Give and receive specific, constructive feedback.
  • Use research and product evidence to prioritize opportunities, evaluate concepts, and improve shipped workflows.
  • Communicate design rationale, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.


If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • Required:
    • 5+ years experience designing complex B2B software, enterprise platforms, or products for technical users.
    • A security background, such as security product design, security operations, threat detection, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, SOC workflows, SIEM, EDR, SOAR, or a related discipline.
    • Understanding of security practitioners’ realities, including noisy signals, incomplete evidence, time pressure, and high-consequence decisions.
    • Strong product thinking and interaction-design skills, with the ability to make complex technical workflows simple without oversimplifying them.
    • Experience designing AI-assisted, agentic, conversational, or other emerging interaction models.
    • Expert Figma skills, including advanced prototyping and design documentation.
    • Demonstrated expertise working in and contributing to design systems. You know when to use existing patterns and when to extend them thoughtfully.
    • Understanding of AI tools and AI UX interaction models is required. You can design experiences where AI assists, recommends, generates, investigates, or takes action while preserving user understanding, control, and trust.
    • Experience collaborating closely with Product and Engineering in an iterative and changing environment.
    • Strong communication, facilitation, and problem solving skills, including the ability to make progress when information is incomplete.
    • A portfolio with case studies that show your role, process, decisions, collaboration, and outcomes. Candidates will be asked to present and discuss previous work.
  • Highly desired:
    • Familiarity with research tools such as Dovetail, including transcripts, tagging, themes, repositories, and insights.
    • Experience with security data, detections, alerts, investigations, threat intelligence, telemetry, data pipelines, or analytical workflows.
    • Experience designing for roles, permissions, tenants, environments, or different levels of technical expertise.
  • A plus
    • Understanding of accessible product design and inclusive interaction practices.
    • Familiarity with WCAG principles, keyboard interactions, focus management, semantic structure, color contrast, and accessible content patterns.
    • Familiarity with OCSF, MITRE ATT&CK, KQL, Sigma, detection rules, threat intelligence, or related concepts.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cribl-sr-ux-designer-security
